title: 🐛 Fix openapi generation with responses kwarg
description:
This PR fixes a bug where the schema of response models defined via the [`responses`](https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/additional-responses/?h=responses) keyword where generated as `validation` schema instead of `serialization` schema.

Additional discussions for that topic:
- #10596
- #9856
